source_issues.finding: Source metadata uses singular Language rather than contract Languages. Preserved rather than silently normalizing.
Sum of all N roots is zero requires N > 1; N=1 gives 1. Scalar roots themselves are not the orthogonal basis vectors; the DFT character vectors are. Both source claims preserved.

Unqualified complex multiplication is rotation plus scaling, not always pure 2D rotation; nearby context uses unit modulus. Exact 1.0/euler(pi) values in floating-point implementations require tolerance. Preserved source wording.
English subtraction question is awkward but means 3 minus 5. Chinese renders that meaning without changing mathematical direction.
A standalone j is an identifier in Python, while a suffix such as 1j denotes an imaginary literal. Source calls j a literal; retained.
